Claude plugins: 3 steps to install one, paid plans only. Not on the Free plan.

1. Open - Click Customize, then open the Plugins tab.
2. Discover - Browse Discover and click Add on a plugin you trust.
3. Customize - In Cowork, click Customize for a guided setup. Plugins bundle skills and connectors.
